Maria: Quick sync — planning release announcement for Thursday 14:00 PT. Need final changelog link and doc landing page. Anyone blocking?
Ashley: Changelog draft is at https://redwood.dev/changelog/2026-03-25 (PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/418). Need one more sign-off on runtime notes.
Leo: Docs landing is staged at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-25 — waiting on Ashley's runtime blurb. Also will compress images for faster load.
Sam: Webinar scheduled same day 11:00 PT — 30m demo + 15m Q&A. Marketing will push registration after docs are live.
Maria: Can we have docs live by 10:00 PT so marketing has a 4-hour QA window and can schedule social + email? Also need a short benchmark blurb + artifact link.
Aisha: Bench artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/2026-03-25/latency-report.pdf. TL;DR for changelog: "95th percentile token latency reduced by 18% on Redwood-optimized kernels". I'll paste the blurb into the changelog PR once approved.
Ashley: I can paste the runtime blurb at 08:30 PT and merge the changelog PR by 09:00 PT. Can ops run a canary from 09:30–10:30 PT? @Jordan / @eng-sre
Jordan: Canary window OK. I'll reserve capacity in us-west1 and enable dark-traffic routing at 10% for the canary. Will post DeployBot updates when it starts.
Maria: Perfect. Marketing plan: announce at 14:00 PT, registration email at 12:05 PT. Need final hero screenshot from design by 09:15 PT.
Hannah: Uploading hero screenshot now: https://assets.redwood.ai/hero/2026-03-25.png — optimized (300kb). I can export alternate widths on request.
Sam: For lead routing, please add tracking params: ?utm_source=announce&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=release-mar25 to all outbound links. Who owns inbound triage?
Priya: Sales will own inbound triage. Please set webhook to /integrations/lead-routing/release-mar25 and include contact list for follow-up.
Maria: I'll add the tracking params and webhook. After the changelog PR merges I'll paste final docs + registration links into the PR comment so marketing has canonical URLs for the announce.
Ashley: No blockers from eng. I'll merge by 09:00 PT and ping here after merge. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: DeployBot: starting canary at 2026-03-25T09:30:00Z — will report progress in this thread.
Maria: Thanks everyone — if anything slips, ping me and we'll shift the announce window.
